The tenant's "All jobs was done" (event-020) is vague and names a contractor, Richard, who is not in the case. No provider is assigned (event-014, event-018), and there is no invoice, quote or approved amount. Completion is therefore unverified, and the closing policy rules out CLOSE. I asked the tenant to confirm that the window now closes (staged message-2). I asked the landlord to confirm completion, the contractor and the invoice position (staged message-1). Escalation is not needed because both parties can answer, and this is routine with no hazard. The partly open window was a concern in event-013 but is not a reported danger. A tenant reply that the window is still faulty, or a landlord reply that the record belongs to another property, would change the decision. The mismatched record may mean the landlord has another property, which a person may later want to check.
